title: Two Hours of Training on openHAB and Using Webhooks from WordPress to Control Alexa Devices
description: We are looking for an openHAB expert to prepare and deliver two hours of training on how to integrate an external website (on WordPress) to openHAB using webhooks or API in order to pass text commands to Alexa devices and check for status (e.g., on, off, etc.) of devices. The goal is to train a small number of business users (with entry-level programming skills in JavaScript and PHP) on how they can utilize webhooks and/or API calls to openHAB to control smart devices attached to Amazon's Alexa and to update the WordPress website with the status of devices. NO WordPress training is needed; participants will already know how to send and receive webhooks or API calls from/ to WordPress. By the conclusion of the training, attendees will have: 1) Learned the basics of openHAB, its models and components (bindings, things, channels, items, rules, and scripts) 2) Learned how to trigger Alexa TextCommands by sending a webhook or API request to openHAB from a WordPress site 3) Learned how to return to the WordPress site status information for Alexa-connected devices from openHAB 4) Sent their first TextCommand request to Alexa 5) Polled (send inquiry to) openHAB for status information of one Alexa-connected device The course can be divided into two 1-hr sessions if desired, or delivered as a single 2-hr session. The training must be delivered live, in English, via teleconference (Zoom, Google Meet, etc.). Participants will attend from the Eastern time zone of the US. The sessions should be instructor led with Q&A all throughout. Prior reading or videos (e.g., YouTube tutorials, sections from the openHAB documentation, etc.) can be assigned for participants to review prior to the training. The live sessions will be recorded ONLY by us the client, will be owned by us the client, and may not be shared with any outside parties as the business content is CONFIDENTIAL. The courses should cover the following content: Session 1 - openHAB basics: - Introduction to openHAB Bindings, Things, Channels, Items & Models - Review of popular Bindings - Explanation of Models - How to create Things, Items, and Channels - How to create Pages to control devices - How to create Rules - How to create Scripts - How to Create Schedules - Introduction to openHAB Cloud and the functionality it provides vs the local openHAB server application - Any other introductory content deemed beneficial by instructor Session 2 – HANDS ON SESSION: Using Webhooks or API to send commands to Alexa devices via openHAB request (Participants will screen share and write their first requests along with the instructor) - How to receive a webhook or API request in openHAB Cloud to trigger an action, rule, or script, to include the syntax and payload - How to create the trigger that will listen for the webhook or API call and start an action - How to send the TextCommand to Alexa and confirm successful receipt - How to communicate success or failure of the request back to the WordPress site via webhook - How to poll openHAB to send state (e.g., on, off, etc.) information from devices back to WordPress website via webhook - Any other content deemed beneficial by instructor The content above may be modified by the openHAB instructor for time and impact in consultation with us. What we are trying to accomplish: After the training, participants should be able to control Alexa devices from a WordPress site. For example, a cron job on the WordPress site may trigger a request to openHAB to send a command to an Amazon thermostat in order to turn off the lights at a location when a guest checks out of the property. As another example, a cron job may send a request to openHAB to send a command to Alexa to turn on the HVAC at a property an hour before a guest is scheduled to arrive. Lastly, an admin dashboard on the WordPress site may give users the ability to see the status of lights and other devices at the property and control them from the WordPress site. openHAB experts are invited to apply
